_doc: Levels. 'xp_per_minute' XP for every minute focused, plus 'gift_bonus' for the gift a walk brought; your XP total is saved, so a change here counts from the next walk. Going from level n to n+1 takes xp_base + xp_growth * (n - 1) XP, so level 2 is at 60 XP (an hour), level 3 at 140, and so on; your level is worked out from these each time, so changing them moves everyone's level at once. What each level unlocks is the 'unlock' on each animal (animals.json) and place (biomes.json).
